I5.quote: The chemical surface structure of Ti-decorated single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWNTs) is studied.

notes: Experimental XPS surface-chemistry study (not theoretical, not electrochemical), so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated. The paper never exposes the samples to H2; its own conclusion speaks only of potential use: 'Li can possibly be used as an agent to reduce oxidized titanium and hence “liberate” Ti atoms for adsorption of hydrogen molecules' (main, p. 4, Section 4 Conclusions). Research article with data, record is_retracted false, no retraction notice, no statement of prior publication, so not_primary, retracted and duplicate_data do not apply. No surface area is reported either, but I4 is not assessed under the I1 rule.
